title: Implement site-template scaffold
description: Create the static site template scaffold that forms the base of every exported landing page. Standalone HTML/CSS/JS file structure, no Next.js dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: index.html template with placeholder tokens for dynamic content
styles.css with base reset and CSS custom properties for theming
No React or Next.js imports — pure vanilla HTML/CSS
Template renders correctly when opened directly in a browser
All 21 section types have corresponding HTML template snippets
Verify by opening template in browser

steps.description: Create src/templates/site/ directory and base files
steps.details: Create: index.html (base shell with `<head>`, `<body>`, nav, footer placeholders), styles.css (CSS reset + palette custom properties: `--color-primary`, `--color-secondary`, `--color-accent`, `--bg`, `--text`, etc.).

For each of the 21 section types, create a `sections/{type}.html` snippet with Handlebars-style `{{variable}}` placeholders. Example: `sections/hero.html` with `{{headline}}`, `{{subheadline}}`, `{{ctaText}}`, `{{backgroundImage}}`.
Create `scripts.js` with minimal JavaScript: mobile nav toggle, smooth scrolling, lazy image loading. No frameworks.
Open src/templates/site/index.html in a browser. Verify it renders without errors (placeholder tokens visible). Verify CSS variables are declared.

technicalNotes: The template will be processed by the export engine (TASK-86) which replaces tokens with real content.
Keep it framework-free — the exported site must work with no server.
